title: dashboardMutationApi special-cases RENDER_PLAN/END_PLANNING before the mounted client
answers: How does a plan preview open a dashboard that isn't loaded yet?
Why does dashboardMutationApi.execute not go straight to currentClient() for RENDER_PLAN?
Why does getAvailableCommands() list RENDER_PLAN even with no dashboard open?
body: dashboardMutationApi.execute (public/app/features/plugins/components/restrictedGrafanaApis/dashboardMutation/dashboardMutationApi.ts) checks mutation.type against 'RENDER_PLAN'/'END_PLANNING' *before* looking up currentClient(), routing those two to a module-level DashboardPlanPreview instance instead. This is what lets a caller request a preview from any page (e.g. Explore) without a dashboard scene mounted yet — DashboardPlanPreview navigates to /dashboard/new and waits for the client to appear via the same client-registration hook (see onClientDeactivated in the client-unregister callback). Because of this, getAvailableCommands() always includes 'RENDER_PLAN' in its result even when currentClient() is null. Any new command needing to work before a dashboard is mounted must follow this same interception pattern rather than relying on currentClient().
applies: Adding or modifying commands in the dashboard/notebook mutation API that need to work outside an already-mounted scene, or changing how getAvailableCommands() is computed.
